name: P15
command:
mkdir -p /tmp/goptyprobe && cd /tmp/goptyprobe && cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"

	"github.com/creack/pty"
)

func main() {
	cmd := exec.Command("/bin/sh", "-c", "echo go-pty-ok")
	f, err := pty.Start(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("ERR", err)
		return
	}
	defer f.Close()
	buf := make([]byte, 256)
	n, _ := f.Read(buf)
	fmt.Printf("OUT %q\n", string(buf[:n]))
	_ = cmd.Wait()
}
EOF
cat > go.mod <<'EOF'
module goptyprobe

go 1.24.0

require github.com/creack/pty v1.1.24

replace github.com/creack/pty => /Users/james/go/pkg/mod/github.com/creack/pty@v1.1.24
EOF
GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go build -o /tmp/goptyprobe/goptyprobe . 2>&1 | head -5 && echo "built" && ls -la /tmp/goptyprobe/goptyprobe
